characterList.description: A man with dark hair, a mustache and a beard wearing a white t-shirt with blue drawings on it.
characterList.name: Dr. Md Amirul Alam

content_metadata.description: This video showcases a detailed and practical demonstration of the tomato flower emasculation and cross-pollination procedure, led by Dr. Md Amirul Alam.

qAndA.question: How many petals does the tomato flower have?

qAndA.answer: Open flowers can't be used for emasculation because they might have already completed their pollination.
qAndA.question: Why can't the speaker use open flowers for emasculation?
What color are the anthers of the tomato flower?

qAndA.answer: The speaker uses a zip lock bag to protect the flower from any unwanted pollination after emasculation.
qAndA.question: Why does the speaker use a plastic bag?

qAndA.answer: Tagging and bagging allows for identification and prevents contamination of the hybridized flower until harvesting and seed collection.
qAndA.question: Why is tagging and bagging important?
